---
title: "Current vs Usual"
subtitle: "How do today's buoy conditions compare to the past five years?"
author: "USGS / SECOORA ERDDAP"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: cosmo
    css: styles.css
    nav-buttons:
      - icon: github
        href: https://github.com/usf-imars/fl-bay-usgs-buoy-explorer
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r setup}
#| output: false

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(htmltools)
library(leaflet)
library(scales)

source("R/fetch_ndbc_history.R")
source("R/fetch_ndbc_observations.R")
source("R/plot_ndbc_context.R")
source("R/plot_ndbc_field.R")
source("R/load_field_data.R")

lookback_years <- 5
lookback_days <- lookback_years * 365

history_raw <- fetch_ndbc_network_history(lookback_days = lookback_days)
data_as_of <- fetch_ndbc_erddap_end_time()
data_as_of_label <- format_ndbc_time(data_as_of)
report_time <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z", tz = ndbc_display_tz)

sal_history <- prepare_ndbc_history(history_raw$salinity, "salinity")
temp_history <- prepare_ndbc_history(history_raw$temperature, "temperature")

sal_latest <- latest_ndbc_readings(sal_history, "salinity")
temp_latest <- latest_ndbc_readings(temp_history, "temperature")

sal_summary <- station_context_summary(sal_history, sal_latest, "salinity")
temp_summary <- station_context_summary(temp_history, temp_latest, "temperature")

sal_counts <- network_context_counts(sal_summary)
temp_counts <- network_context_counts(temp_summary)

sal_daily <- network_daily_means(sal_history, "salinity")
temp_daily <- network_daily_means(temp_history, "temperature")

sal_clim <- doy_climatology(sal_history, "salinity")
temp_clim <- doy_climatology(temp_history, "temperature")

sal_network_ctx <- network_daily_context(sal_daily, sal_clim, "salinity", lookback_years)
temp_network_ctx <- network_daily_context(temp_daily, temp_clim, "temperature", lookback_years)

sal_qc_label <- ndbc_qc_label("salinity")
temp_qc_label <- ndbc_qc_label("temperature")

sal_ndbc <- fetch_ndbc_hourly_snapshots(
  param = "sea_water_practical_salinity",
  value_col = "salinity"
)
temp_ndbc <- fetch_ndbc_hourly_snapshots(
  param = "sea_water_temperature",
  value_col = "temperature"
)

ref_date_label <- format(sal_ndbc$reference_date, "%Y-%m-%d")

salinity_fields <- interpolate_or_load_fields(
  sal_ndbc$snapshots,
  value_col = "salinity"
)
temperature_fields <- interpolate_or_load_fields(
  temp_ndbc$snapshots,
  value_col = "temperature"
)

salinity_palette <- c(
  "#2166ac", "#67a9cf", "#d1e5f0",
  "#fddbc7", "#ef8a62", "#b2182b"
)
temperature_palette <- c(
  "#313695", "#74add1", "#abd9e9",
  "#fee090", "#f46d43", "#a50026"
)

sal_field_range <- field_value_range(salinity_fields, "salinity")
temp_field_range <- field_value_range(temperature_fields, "temperature")
sal_range <- sal_field_range
temp_range <- temp_field_range
```

::: {.content-visible when-format="dashboard"}
**Usual** = each buoy's readings over the past **`r lookback_years` years**, compared by **day of year** (10th–90th percentile band). Data from [SECOORA ERDDAP](https://erddap.secoora.org/erddap/index.html). **Report:** `r report_time` · **Latest data:** `r data_as_of_label`
:::

# Overview

## Row

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: High salinity buoys
#| icon: arrow-up-circle
#| color: warning
list(value = sal_counts$n_high)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: Usual salinity buoys
#| icon: check-circle
#| color: success
list(value = sal_counts$n_usual)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: High temperature buoys
#| icon: thermometer-high
#| color: danger
list(value = temp_counts$n_high)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: Usual temperature buoys
#| icon: thermometer-half
#| color: info
list(value = temp_counts$n_usual)
```

## Row {height=35%}

::: {.card title="Network mean salinity"}
`r format_network_context(sal_network_ctx, "PSU")`

The **network mean** averages all valid buoy readings each day. The chart overlays each calendar year on Jan–Dec (day of year): older years as thin black lines, the latest year in orange. The shaded band shows the across-buoy usual range for each day (10th–90th percentile across the past `r lookback_years` years); the dashed line is the climatological median.
:::

::: {.card title="Network mean temperature"}
`r format_network_context(temp_network_ctx, "°C")`

The **network mean** averages all valid buoy readings each day. The chart overlays each calendar year on Jan–Dec (day of year): older years as thin black lines, the latest year in orange. The shaded band shows the across-buoy usual range for each day (10th–90th percentile across the past `r lookback_years` years); the dashed line is the climatological median.
:::

## Row {height=40%}

::: {.card title="How to read this dashboard"}
A buoy is **low** when its latest reading falls below the 10th percentile of its own past **`r lookback_years`-year** record; **high** when above the 90th percentile; **usual** otherwise. This is not a fixed salinity/temperature threshold — it adapts to each station's history and season.

Distribution plots show the QC-filtered **`r lookback_years`-year** record (all buoys pooled). Station bars show where today's reading ranks at each buoy (0 = lowest on record, 100 = highest). Interpolated maps show **DIVAnd** hourly fields on `r ref_date_label` for the variable on each page.

Outliers and sentinel values are removed before analysis (salinity `r sal_qc_label` PSU; temperature `r temp_qc_label` °C).
:::

# Salinity

## Row {height=55%}

```{r sal-distribution}
#| title: Salinity distribution (past `r lookback_years` years)
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 5

if (nrow(sal_history) == 0) {
  stop("No salinity history returned from ERDDAP.")
}

plot_context_distribution(
  sal_history,
  sal_latest,
  value_col = "salinity",
  title = sprintf("Salinity distribution (past %d years)", lookback_years),
  unit = "Salinity (PSU)"
)
```

```{r sal-percentiles}
#| title: Latest salinity percentile by buoy
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 5

plot_station_percentiles(
  sal_summary,
  value_col = "salinity",
  title = "Where today falls in each buoy's history",
  unit = "Salinity (PSU)"
)
```

```{r sal-field-24}
  value_col = "salinity",
  legend_title = "Salinity (PSU)",
  popup_suffix = " PSU",
  palette = salinity_palette,
  value_range = sal_range
)
```

### Column {width=50%}

```{r sal-network-year}
#| title: Network mean by year
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 4.5

plot_network_mean_by_year(
  sal_daily,
  sal_clim,
  title = "Network mean salinity by year",
  unit = "Salinity (PSU)",
```
